judgment_calls.decision: Urgent, as the red box says "Give urgent attention".
judgment_calls.alternatives: Very urgent, matching the Focal neurology warning sign (that sign already fires Very urgent independently).

judgment_calls.alternatives: probable (the page gives no confirming logic).

judgment_calls.decision: Urgent on any one of the 15 sudden-onset stroke symptoms, a recorded stroke (Focal neurology warning sign) or a New TIA; the red box has no 'and any of' list.
judgment_calls.alternatives: priority on the possible-stroke diagnosis (A); dropped as redundant with the same symptoms listed explicitly.

judgment_calls.decision: Check task fires on any of the stroke symptoms without the onset qualifier, or on the recorded stroke warning sign.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Dizziness only, or the possible-stroke diagnosis (circular: it only fires from findings this task records).

judgment_calls.decision: No TIA diagnosis rule; "lasted < 24 hours and resolved completely" cannot be expressed. A New TIA is checked for and makes the patient Urgent.
judgment_calls.alternatives: possible TIA from the same symptoms (would not distinguish from stroke).

judgment_calls.decision: Impairment of balance (finding), the parent of Poor balance and Unable to balance.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Poor balance (B), Unable to balance (A, has 'loss of balance' as a synonym).
